Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by concluding that Shia Islam was the dominant Islamic denomination among the countries surrounding Armenia and provided the percentage of Shia Muslims in Nigeria. This conclusion was incorrect because the task was to identify the percentage of Nigeria's population that practiced Islam in general (not specifically Shia Islam), which is dominant in the countries surrounding Armenia primarily in terms of overall Muslim populations (including Sunni, which is more prevalent in those regions). The Planner over-specified by focusing on Shia Islam rather than considering the general Islamic population in Nigeria, leading to reporting an incorrect 6% figure instead of the general 48.8% Muslim population figure.
